finding: Ranks with an empty trailing-row partition execute continue before the MPI_Allgather and MPI_Allgatherv required by ranks with nonempty work. At n=513 and 128 ranks the panel ending at je=448 leaves only 65 rows: ranks 65 through 127 skip those collectives and advance to the next panel's broadcasts, while ranks 0 through 64 still need the gathers. This is an invalid collective sequence; empty ranks must participate with zero counts.
observed_failure: The correctness execution reaches factorization but times out after 30 seconds, without a numerical result. Its paired r4 observation passes in 19.96 seconds.
interpretation: Static source establishes a topology-dependent collective mismatch, consistent with the timeout and independent of concurrent scheduling. The exact dynamic blocking call was not traced. Retain the failure without retry.
investigation: Static inspection and retained validation output; no new program execution.
